properties.description: What awaits the owner's word: DesignGraph::awaiting_word lists built work whose record is still open, each item with what delivers it (evidence_ids, evidence) and the call that closes it. Two families: a proposed Requirement the shared arrival predicate reads as Delivered (with requirement_delivered_by's capabilities or delivered parts), and a proposed Decision whose promotion has landed (ideas_whose_promotion_landed, the promotion detector's own population). It rides loop_status's owner-scoped answer as awaiting_word, beside assigned_decisions and questions_put_to_them, and moves no status. Added 2026-10-13 for fact:root-cause-built-work-stays-open-because-its-record-is-kept-by-hand-and-the-ship-moves-only-the-capability-2026-10-13.
